item.title: OXB trims 2026 revenue guidance despite record client wins
item.summary: OXB has cut its full-year revenue guidance, blaming a short-term shift in client ordering, even as the cell and gene therapy manufacturer reported solid first-half growth and record new business. The Oxford-based group said H1 revenue rose about 9% to roughly £80m, and that it signed 17 new clients in the period, more than 30% […] The post OXB trims 2026 revenue guidance despite record client wins appeared first on UK Investor Magazine .
